Catégorie Technologies énergétiques
SeasON: l’énergie d’aujourd’hui – la chaleur de demain (Today’s energy – tomorrow’s warmth).
A unique and innovative energy solution has been in operation in Frauenfeld (TG) since autumn 2024: the SeasON sorption storage heat pump, developed by the Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts (HSLU) and Matica AG from Kaltenbach in the canton of Thurgau."}]}
